configured_test.rule: configured(env) is true when EITHER (a) env.STRATUM_SESSION_SCRIPTS_DIR is a non-empty string, OR (b) the Stratum USER config file (env.STRATUM_CONFIG_FILE if non-empty, else ~/.stratum/config.toml; stratum/ts/src/config/index.ts:106) exists and holds a [session] table, OR (c) that file is not proven absent (errno other than ENOENT/ENOTDIR) but cannot be read or parsed: configured-and-broken (U1 fix round 1). Nothing else makes it true or false. Owner Q2 (2026-10-19 17:59, via s1-chat): not configured = pass through; configured = every failure refuses.
configured_test.stratum_impl: U1: parsed with the existing TOML loader. A [session] table in a PROJECT stratum.toml (index.ts:107) is a config error naming the file: scripts_dir is never taken from a repository file.
configured_test.compose_impl: U13 (fix round 2, R2-H1). Compose never decides 'configured' while the stratum CLI resolves: admitClaude ALWAYS runs `stratum session admit --json` and Stratum's TOML parse decides (mode none returns the candidate env unchanged). sessionConfigured(env) is used ONLY when resolveStratumBin('cli') throws, and it is a conservative SUPERSET of Stratum's rule (Compose has no TOML parser): true when (a) as above, OR (b) the user config path is not proven absent: fs.statSync fails with any errno other than ENOENT/ENOTDIR (EACCES on the file or an ancestor, EPERM, EIO, ELOOP, ...) or succeeds (any file or directory at the path, whatever it holds). U1 fix round 1 (review F1/F2): Stratum reads every unreadable or unparseable user file as configured-and-broken, which a text check cannot predict, so Compose's superset is 'anything is there'. So every TOML spelling of the table, every file Stratum cannot read, and every file Stratum cannot parse reads configured. A dangling symlink is ENOENT on its target: absent on both sides. A false positive only refuses a launch that has no stratum CLI anyway (fail closed); a false negative is impossible for any file Stratum would read as configured.
configured_test.fixtures: one shared table (configured-fixtures.json, U1), run by U1 (stratum) and U13 (compose). Rule: on every row, stratum configured => compose configured (compose may say configured where stratum says not, never the reverse); each row records both expected values. Rows: env set / env empty string / env unset; file absent / [session] with scripts_dir / [ session ] with scripts_dir / ["session"] with scripts_dir / ['session'] with scripts_dir / top-level dotted session.scripts_dir / inline session = {scripts_dir = ...} / [session] empty / [session] commented out (stratum: no, compose: yes) / [sandbox] only (both no) / [sandbox] with a string value containing 'session' (stratum: no, compose: yes) / file unreadable (compose: configured, stratum: config error = configured-and-broken) / ancestor directory unreadable (both: configured; stratum broken) / path is a directory (same) / dangling symlink (both: not configured) / TOML parse error without the word session, env unset and env set (both: configured; stratum broken). U1 fix round 1: [sandbox] only reads compose configured (file present). U13 runs every row twice: once with the stratum CLI stub present (Compose follows the stub's admit answer, its own detector is never called: asserted by a spy) and once with the CLI absent (stratum-configured rows => backend-unavailable, no spawn).
configured_test.configured_but_broken: configured with no usable scripts_dir (absent, empty, not a directory), a missing script, a missing python, a missing stratum CLI (Compose), a user config file that is not proven absent but cannot be read (any stat/read errno other than ENOENT/ENOTDIR, or not a regular file), or any TOML parse error of the user file (whatever its text, env set or not) = refusal backend-unavailable for every op, admit included. Never pass-through.

scripts_dir.config: [session] scripts_dir in the Stratum USER config only; env wins

backend.exec: argv only (spawn with an argv array, shell false, own process group; never a shell; U1 review F5 wording 2026-10-19), cwd unchanged, one timeout per op (timeout_s below), the child's process group killed on timeout. stdout is parsed as ONE JSON document and checked against the op's script_output shape; anything else is a backend-error refusal, never a guess. stderr is kept (first 500 chars) for the refusal reason.
backend.stdin: closed ('ignore') for every op EXCEPT admit: admit writes marker_text (at most 262144 bytes, the gate's FILE_CAP, work_model_gate.py:73; longer = truncated to the head) to the child's stdin and ends the stream. marker_text never appears in argv, logs or output.
backend.child_env_rule: The script's env is the CANDIDATE CHILD ENV the caller will launch with (operations.admit.child_env), minus CLAUDECODE and minus LAUNCH_GATE_ADMITTED (an inherited admission marker is never trusted). For ops other than admit and launch it is the front door's own process env with the same two removals.

modes.none: configured(env) false. admit returns {ok:true, op:'admit', backend:'none', data:{admitted:true, code:null, reason:'session backend not configured', engine, account:null, env:{}, checks:[], launch_gate_label:null}} and the caller launches with its candidate env unchanged (today's behaviour). Every other op returns refusal backend-unconfigured.
modes.scripts: configured(env) true. Every op runs its script; every failure is a refusal (configured_but_broken). admit success always returns a non-empty env naming the engine home (operations.admit.script_output.env).

refusal.reason: string (the script's own text, first line, at most 500 chars, env values never included)

refused.record: object | null: the script's parsed stdout when it printed one valid JSON document of the op's script_output shape (pick: the seat table; admit: checks; hop: result, from, to, left_open; launch: refused + reason). null when it printed none. Validated like a success: a refusal whose stdout is JSON of the WRONG shape is backend-error.

envelope.partial: a refusal with cli_exit 5 (hop-not-ready, hop-partial): record is REQUIRED and record.left_open lists every tab left open; a partial without it is backend-error

cli_exit_codes.1: refused by policy (no-eligible-account, account-unknown, account-unset, account-retired, gate-denied, marker-unreadable, launch-gate-refused, hop-refused, detach-refused, registry-refused)
cli_exit_codes.2: usage error (bad argv to stratum session)
cli_exit_codes.3: waited and gave up or held (ahead-of-pace, launch-gate-timeout, hop-busy)
cli_exit_codes.4: backend problem (backend-unconfigured, backend-unavailable, backend-error, backend-timeout, admission-env-mismatch)
cli_exit_codes.5: partial action (hop-partial, hop-not-ready): something was opened or left open; record names it

backend-unconfigured.from: configured(env) false, every op except admit

backend-error.from: script exit not in the op's script_exit map, or stdout not one JSON document / not the contracted shape

backend-timeout.from: the op's timeout_s elapsed; the child's process group is killed

admission-env-mismatch.from: the caller-side check: the env about to be launched does not carry exactly the admitted engine home (library.child_env_check); nothing is launched

no-eligible-account.from: usage_watch pick returned no choice, or a choice whose vendor is not the engine's (session_admit vendor check)

account-unknown.from: account id not a row of the engine's vendor, or the inherited home matches no row or two (detach_job.resolve_account semantics, detach_job.py:313-336)

account-unset.from: engine claude, account 'inherit', and the candidate child env has no non-empty CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (owner Q2: never fall back to ~/.claude when configured; work_model_gate.py:116-117 is that fallback). Reason names the fix: pass account 'auto' or an id.

account-retired.from: seat_limits(...)[id].retired OR seat_limits(...)[id].logged_out is true (usage_watch.py:302-360; MAX-SUNSET-7 adds a persisted marker read by the same function). Logged-out is included because detach_job.resolve_retired_home (detach_job.py:368) treats both alike and would launch on a different account than the one admitted; the reason names which ('is retired' or 'is logged-out'), and a logged-out account is recoverable by a login, a retired one is not. Amended 2026-10-19 forge-e0 (U9 pre-land review F3).

gate-denied.from: work_model_gate.judge returned a reason (quota, ceiling, reserve, explicit model, Opus hard:, Fable); reason is the gate's text verbatim

marker-unreadable.from: admit --marker-file given and the path is missing, not a regular file, or not readable (os.access R_OK), checked BEFORE work_model_gate._read_file (work_model_gate.py:388-396), which returns "" for those cases and for an empty file alike. An empty readable file is empty marker text, not a refusal.

launch-gate-timeout.from: launch_gate.py exit 3 after LAUNCH_GATE_MAX_WAIT, which admit ALWAYS sets (launch_gate.py:48)

hop-refused.from: session_hop.py exit 2 in hop / dry-run mode (session_hop.py:13, :104)

mark-mismatch.from: detach_job.py stop exit 3 (not exposed in v1, listed so the map is total)

usage.from: the script's argparse exit 2 (an argv the front door built wrong is a bug, reported, never retried). session_hop's ap.error (session_hop.py:1452) also exits 2: in check mode exit 2 is mapped by script_exit_check, so the front door validates name before running (non-empty, no NUL) and never sends both name and --check.

admit.cli: stratum session admit --engine claude|codex --label LABEL [--model MODEL] [--account inherit|auto|ID] [--marker-file ABS] [--launch-gate full|none] [--max-wait-s N] --json   (marker text on stdin when no --marker-file; the CLI's own process env IS the candidate child env)
admit.mcp: stratum_session_admit (child env = the MCP server's env; marker_text field)
admit.purpose: One question every launch asks before it spawns: which account, may it start now, and with exactly which engine home. Never spawns anything itself.
admit.callers: plan.md ## Admission owners: one row per launch path, who calls admit and with which launch_gate

input.label: string, one token, no leading '-' (launch_gate never takes a label starting with '-', launch_gate.py:24-27)
input.model: string; required for engine claude (work_model_gate.py: no explicit model is denied)
input.account: 'inherit' (default) | 'auto' | an account id of the engine's vendor. inherit: claude reads CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR of the candidate child env and REFUSES account-unset when it is unset or empty (configured mode); codex reads CODEX_HOME, default ~/.codex (detach_job.py:144). Then detach_job.resolve_account semantics (one row of that vendor with that home, else account-unknown). auto: claude = pick(kind 'author') (never an overflow kind, usage_watch.py:70); codex = pick(kind 'review', author_vendor 'claude') (the Codex pool, usage_watch.py:1946). The chosen row's vendor must equal engine, else no-eligible-account.
input.marker_text: string, optional: the launch's own prompt or brief head, where hard: and fable: count (work_model_gate.py:98-102). Sent on stdin (backend.stdin). Never logged.
input.marker_file: absolute path, optional, exclusive with marker_text: session_admit reads it with work_model_gate._read_file (same FILE_CAP and resolution as the gate's own detach_job --brief read, work_model_gate.py:1136-1137); missing / not a regular file / unreadable = marker-unreadable
input.launch_gate: 'full' (spacing, rate, load, fleet; launch_gate.py <label> --engine E) | 'none' (account + judge only). Which callers use which: plan.md ## Admission owners (rule: full when the launch returns before the agent finishes).
input.max_wait_s: number, default 120, range [1, 1800]: ALWAYS exported as LAUNCH_GATE_MAX_WAIT for launch_gate 'full' (unset would wait forever, launch_gate.py:53, :96-97)
input.child_env: library and Compose helper only: the exact env object the caller will hand to spawn / the SDK, BEFORE its own secret scrub. The CLI and MCP use their own process env.

admit.script_stdin: marker_text when given and no marker_file; else empty and closed

script_exit.1: account-unknown | account-unset | account-retired | no-eligible-account | gate-denied | marker-unreadable | launch-gate-refused (output.code says which)

script_output.code: null when admitted, else one refusal_codes key
script_output.account: null | {id, vendor, label, config_dir_name}  (config_dir_name = basename only, e.g. '.claude-seat2')
script_output.env: admitted: EXACTLY one key, the engine home variable (claude: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, codex: CODEX_HOME) set to the chosen row's absolute, resolved config_dir, for every account mode INCLUDING inherit (never empty in mode scripts). Refused: {}. The ONLY place a path is returned. EXCEPTION (default-home rule, plan ## Risks Max row, forge-e0 2026-10-19): for the claude accounts row with default: true (Max, home ~/.claude) the value is JSON null, meaning REMOVE CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR from the child env (an explicit ~/.claude gives Not logged in). Every consumer (U2 launch, U11, U13 assertAdmittedEnv, U14) treats null as delete-and-assert-absent, never as the string null or an empty value. When that row is retired, admit refuses it account-retired and the exception is unused.
script_output.checks: array of {name: 'account'|'retired'|'judge'|'launch-gate', result: 'pass'|'deny'|'skip', detail: string}; judge is 'skip' for codex (work_model_gate judges Claude launches)
script_output.launch_gate_label: string | null: the label recorded in the launches log when launch_gate was 'full'

admit.library_result: the envelope plus childEnv = {...child_env, ...data.env} (mode none: child_env unchanged). Callers launch with childEnv and nothing else.
admit.side_effects: launch_gate 'full' appends one row to the launches log; the judge writes its own decision log line

launch.cli: stratum session launch --session S --label L --engine claude|codex --model M [--effort E] --brief ABS --report ABS [--cwd ABS] [--work-kind K] [--priority P0..P3] [--account inherit|auto|ID] [--max-wait-s N] --json
steps: 1. admit(engine, label, model, account, marker_file = brief, launch_gate 'full', max_wait_s) with child_env = the front door env minus CLAUDECODE and LAUNCH_GATE_ADMITTED. Refused: return that refusal; detach_job never runs.

2. detach_job env = childEnv from step 1 + LAUNCH_GATE_ADMITTED=<label> (detach_job's existing skip, detach_job.py:2822-2825, so the full gate runs once, in admit) + LAUNCH_GATE_MAX_WAIT=<max_wait_s> (a skip that fails can never wait forever).

3. Run script_argv. detach_job.resolve_retired_home returns None for the admitted live home (detach_job.py:368), so it selects no second account; the meta must carry no account_pick (a probe asserts it).
launch.stdout_rule: with --json detach_job prints exactly one JSON document on stdout; any nested launch_gate text goes to stderr (U10)
launch.timeout_s: admit timeout (max_wait_s + 60) for step 1, then 60 for step 3
launch.side_effects: one launches-log row (admit), one detached job, its jobs.py registration (kind detached), its index meta

test_fixture.leak_gate: ISOLATION is the env above (fixture HOME plus every override): no script a test runs may resolve a real path. The leak gate is the DETECTOR for an escape, in two arms (forge-e0 ruling 2026-10-19 after U1-FU review F2; the old 'any change in all five trees' could not stay green: live sessions and launchd write the four noisy trees continuously, measured in units/SESSION-MGMT-1/U1-FU-report.md ## Leak gate). STRICT arm: under the REAL ~/.stratum except ts/agent_runs (other sessions' runs), any added, removed or changed entry (path, kind, size, mtime) fails the suite. TOKEN arm: under the REAL ~/.claude/{logs,session-state,usage}, the ops status/launch-gate dir and ~/.stratum/ts/agent_runs, every test-created name and every value a test writes carries the run token; any added or rewritten entry whose path or CONTENT (whole file, not only appended bytes) carries the token fails the suite, and any REMOVED entry whose path carries the token fails it (content and removal checks: U1-FU4). The content of a removed file is not checked, by design (SESSION-MGMT-1-LEAKGATE-TS-1): the token is minted fresh per run with at least 32 random bits before the baseline listing, so no baseline content can carry it, and a test that rewrites a real pre-existing file and then deletes it is prevented by ISOLATION, not detected. A unit that adds a writer into a noisy tree must show that writer resolves to the fixture under this env (a test row asserts the resolved write path is under the fixture root; never a row that drops an override and lets the script write). Fixture engine processes (DETACH_JOB_ENGINE_OVERRIDE) are killed by process group in teardown, on the failure path too.

library.exports: createSessionBackend(options?: {env?, configPath?}) -> SessionBackend. Methods: pick, admit(input, {childEnv}) -> envelope & {childEnv}, launch, status, fleet, hopCheck(name), hopDryRun(name, to?, reason?), hopLive(name, to?, reason?, force?, allow_closed?), jobsList, jobsRegister, policy. Used by the CLI (U1/U2), the MCP server (U3: never hopLive) and Stratum's runner/background (U11, U12). Compose does NOT import it: it runs `stratum session admit --json` with env = its candidate child env through resolveStratumBin('cli') (plan decision D5).
library.child_env_check: assertAdmittedEnv(finalEnv, admitted): immediately before spawn / SDK query, AFTER the caller's own scrub, finalEnv[homeVar] must equal admitted.data.env[homeVar] (mode scripts) or be untouched from childEnv (mode none); else refusal admission-env-mismatch and no launch. Compose has the same function in session-door.js.
library.compose_helper: compose/server/session-door.js admitClaude({label, model, markerText, projectRoot, childEnv, launchGate, maxWaitS}) -> Promise<{childEnv}> or throws SessionRefusal {code, reason, cliExit}. stratum CLI found -> always runs admit (Stratum decides configured; mode none -> {childEnv} unchanged). stratum CLI not found -> sessionConfigured(childEnv) (backend.configured_test.compose_impl, a superset of Stratum's rule): false -> {childEnv} unchanged; true -> throws backend-unavailable.
